title: Chapter 404 Territory Migration
content:
Chapter 404 Territory Migration

Zhu Dongheng smiled and said, "If you don't use this scroll now, you may not be able to use it later."

This kind of prop belongs to the system prop. In the later stage, only the scroll made by people can be used, and the system prop will be invalid.

Wang Shuo thought carefully about the entire terrain of the Dahuai Domain.

The location of his Wana County is indeed somewhat limited, which is not conducive to defending the Great Wall in the north.

The original three county cities were almost in a straight line, standing in the south of the Steel Great Wall. They were obviously three border cities, echoing the Great Wall from a distance.

The three discussed for a while, and Wang Shuo left Shanhai City.

After returning to Wana County, Wang Shuo informed everyone about the relocation of the city.

Choosing a good day, Wang Shuo came to the old site of Fenglin County, took out the migration axis, and entered the coordinates of Wana County.

In an instant, Wana County and all the people in the county were teleported here.

Wang Shuo was deeply shocked by this great power.

Next, Wang Shuo still has a lot to do.

Rebuild the city wall.

Wang Shuo took out the rewarded golden wall brick production drawings, found Yan Fujie, and told him to learn the production method as soon as possible. All the newly built walls should use this kind of wall bricks.

With the production technology of bronze wall bricks, the difficulty of comprehending golden wall bricks has been reduced a lot.

The original city defense army commander Baili Liang died in the steel Great Wall. Wang Shuo reappointed Li Weiguo as the city defense army commander to be responsible for the security of the territory.

Li Weiguo's sword guard was handed over to the new commander Lin Dabiao.

All construction matters were handed over to Duan Wenxi and Suo Yong.

Military training was handed over to Ayubu, who reorganized and expanded.

What Wang Shuo wanted to do most now was to make his own Shura suit.

Back to the lord's mansion, Wang Shuo remembered his territory guardian beast.

So he went to the backyard, took out a promotion pill, and fed it to the koi.

The koi swallowed the promotion pill in one gulp.

A colorful halo flashed by, and the koi grew bigger and became the size of a goat.

[Koi: Territory guardian beast, in its prime, can increase the territory, the probability of good weather and good harvest, currently 10%. Good harvest, increase the yield of crops in the territory by 20%, and shorten the growth cycle by 10%. ]

Wang Shuo was very happy to see the grown-up koi.

The territory must rely on growing food in the future, I hope this attribute can always be useful!

Back in the hall, Wang Shuo took out the Shura suit blueprint.

[Shura Demon-breaking Spear (production blueprint): Epic equipment, can be upgraded to legendary level with upgraded gems. Strength +1000, Constitution +3000, Attack Power +10000, with the additional skill, Shura Slash, each time you kill an enemy, you will gain Shura rage, when you accumulate enough rage, you can release Shura Slash to cause a lot of damage to the enemy.

Materials required for production: forged steel × 2, Shura wood × 1, high-level magic core × 1, soul crystal × 10. 】

Wang Shuo fell into deep thought when he saw these materials.

Then he took out the drawings of Shura armor, Shura boots, etc., and shook his head after checking them.

There are too many materials needed, and they are all high-level materials.

Wang Shuo thought that after the Black Dragon King was purified, he didn't know if there was any demon pill left.

He also didn't know whether the demon pill could replace the magic core.

Wang Shuo immediately asked Zhao Bangde through the friend channel.

Zhao Bangde said that he did leave one, and after Wang Shuo expressed his intention, Zhao Bangde also readily agreed and gave it to Wang Shuo.

But Zhao Bangde was powerless with the remaining materials.

Wang Shuo immediately summoned the merchant Hadro.
